mentions.name: tabSidian
mentions.description: A browser extension that saves a list of all open tabs into a markdown document. The output is formatted with a templating language and can be saved directly to an Obsidian vault; if no vault is available, it provides a downloadable markdown file and a clipboard copy. Links to browser extension stores are available on its GitHub page.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a browser extension that lets you save a list of all your open tabs into a markdown document. You can format the output using a templating language and it saves direct to your Obsidian vault if you have one (otherwise gives you a markdown file to download, plus a clipboard copy).
